Maria (CS): Quick triage: PolarisHealth showing a sharp drop in active users this month (~50% seats inactive). New Head of Data joined and is running a vendor re-eval (mentioned ApexAI). Renewal in ~3 weeks — need coordinated response.
Tanay (SE): Any sign of errors/latency? Could be product flow change.
Maria (CS): No errors. Telemetry snippet below. Mostly generation volume fell, embeddings steady.
Maria (CS): ```telemetry 30d
- total_calls: 11,900 -> 6,100
- active_seats: 20 -> 10
- gen_tokens/day: 300k -> 150k
- embeds/day: 3.1k -> 2.8k
```
Julia (CSM): Champion Nora confirmed ML team paused an internal pilot while the new Head does a cost/quality sweep. They flagged cost predictability as main concern.
Mike (AE): Proposed playbook: 1) quick perf+cost compare vs ApexAI 2) offer 2-week Dedicated trial for their ML team 3) intro call with Head of Data and engineering. Thoughts?
Tanay (SE): Sounds good. I'll build a one-pager showing latency SLOs, tail latencies, and unit cost at their seq length (~512 typical). Also include how batching/quantization affects cost.
Maria (CS): Nora said occasional 1024 seqs. Link to dashboard will be shared in call invite.
Julia (CSM): I'll prepare a short usage narrative and a focused ask list they can take to the Head of Data. Also prepare an eval prompt set to compare quality vs their baseline.
ops-bot: Reminder: PolarisHealth renewal in 21 days — owner: Mike (AE).
Mike (AE): I'll schedule a 30m intro Fri 9am PT. Julia + Tanay can join. Can someone draft the Dedicated trial terms?
Maria (CS): I'll draft a short Dedicated trial offer (2 weeks, 2x baseline throughput, fixed-cost pilot, engineering office hours).
Tanay (SE): I'll attach a microbench run log and a 1-slide cost sensitivity table.
Julia (CSM): If Head of Data asks about rollouts, we should highlight canary and version pinning + audit logs. I'll add that to the one-pager.
Maria (CS): Action list: Mike schedule call; Tanay perf one-pager + bench; Julia usage narrative + eval set; Maria trial terms. Aim to circulate by EOD Thursday so they have time.
Mike (AE): Will send invite and materials. If they request, we can stand up a short no-cost trial to mirror their pipeline.
Maria (CS): I'll log CS ticket #CS-3421 and add meeting notes after the call. Keep eyes open for competitor claims in the call. :eyes:
Tanay (SE): Noted — will include traces we can run during the call to rebut latency/cost claims.
Julia (CSM): Thanks team — will follow up with Nora to confirm participants.
Mike (AE): On it.
Maria (CS): Closing: we should capture any security/compliance asks early if they consider Private deployment.
ops-bot: Ticket CS-3421 updated: next step scheduled.
